definition: relating to the teeth and their care
description: A bright dental clinic. A young woman in a lilac top lies back in a blue dentist's chair, laughing with her mouth wide open. A student in a white coat and blue gloves holds a small dental mirror at her teeth. All around them, young students in teal and grey scrubs lean in to watch; some laugh and cover their mouths, and one holds up a model of a set of teeth. Cabinets, a big round lamp and a window with a tree are behind them.
